Jordan (People Ops): quick note 9: were rolling a small handbook update on Fri 11:00 PT: 'Office & home stipends + contractor guidance'. Changes: new caps, explicit contractor callout, and a one-page manager checklist. flag blockers now. :loudspeaker:

Felix (Payroll): Will this change how stipends hit payroll? Need the import format and effective pay period.

Jordan (People Ops): Effective with the first pay period in July. No retro pay. We'll provide a CSV with ack_version.

Amira (Legal): For contractor language, we must avoid implying benefits. Drafting a short clause: "Contractors: check your contract or contact ops@redwood.com." Will add VAT/tax note for EU.

Sven (EMEA Ops): translations for EMEA will take ~4 business days. recommend publish master with "localized addendum coming" banner. Also some countries treat stipend as taxable income.

Priya (Translations): we can turn around the short snippets in 3 days if copy is final. keep strings short.

Felix (Payroll): CSV headers I need: employee_id,full_name,email,region,employment_type,stipend_amount,paid_via,ack_version,ack_ts,notes. include contractor_flag as well.

Jordan (People Ops): added `contractor_flag`. managers will get an 8-item checklist and a 3-minute micro-cert for employees. completion due by July 15.

Amira (Legal): also recommend adding a link to local legal addenda for EU/UK. I'll post the addenda here when ready.

ack-bot: Reminder scheduled: managers will receive DMs on publish; reminders at day 3 and day 10. Use `/ack-bot export --since 2026-07-01 --format csv` to pull ack data.

Felix (Payroll): I'll validate the mapping once comp posts the country table. confirm by Thursday EOD.

Jordan (People Ops): action recap: (1) publish master Fri 11:00 PT, (2) legal addendum for EU/UK, (3) comp to post country tax table, (4) payroll to validate CSV, (5) translations follow as they land. any objections?

Sven (EMEA Ops): no objections from EMEA.

Felix (Payroll): no objections, will confirm by Thu.

Jordan (People Ops): thanks all 1: will post the prod link and manager TL;DR after publish.
